'''Krash''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] member of the [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3641 BBY]] he was overseeing the testing of experimental stims on captured [[Pantran whitefang]]s in the [[Starship Graveyard (Hoth)|Starship Graveyard]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. The operation was dismantled by a Republic operative and Krash was killed in the fighting.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Overseer Krash appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an NPC on Hoth, who is the final boss of the exploration mission "Unethical Experiments."
